features: Fixes Competitor Portal Current Division options so they change with the selected dance style
Bachata profile now offers Novice, Intermediate, Advanced, Bachata Rising, Bachata Open, Bachata Invitational, Semi Pro, Pro and Bachata All Star
Salsa profile remains limited to Novice, Intermediate and Advanced
The Salsa division limitation note is displayed only when Salsa is selected
Adds server-side discipline validation so a Salsa request cannot submit a Bachata-only division by manipulating the form
Keeps one shared BDC ID while storing competition profile requests against the selected Bachata or Salsa discipline
